title: 第十九章 对手第二十章 停车场
lines: 柜台装修到第十二天的时候，老李把最后一块玻璃安上了。
沈南枝站在柜台前面看了很久。白色的墙面，深色的木头货柜，暖色的射灯打下来，照在玻璃展柜里那几件银花样品上。银丝编的花瓣在灯光下亮得晃眼，花心里镶的紫水晶透出一小片紫色的光，投在底下的绒布上，像一小汪水。
何婉清站在她旁边，抱着胳膊看了一会儿，从包里拿出一个卷尺，量了量展柜和门口的距离。
“收银台放这边，”她指了指靠墙的位置，“顾客进来先看展柜，看完到这边结账。动线要顺，不能让人来回绕。”
沈南枝点了点头，在脑子里把整个布局过了一遍。进门正对展柜，左手边是耳环和手链，右手边是项链和胸针，最里面是收银台。顾客从门口进来，自然会被展柜吸引，然后顺着货架往里走，看完一圈正好到收银台。不绕路，不回头。
桂姨蹲在地上擦货架的底部，擦得很仔细，连最底层的隔板都擦了三遍。张嫂在往墙上钉挂钩，一锤子下去，钉歪了，拔出来重钉，墙上留下一个小坑。何婉清皱了皱眉，没说话，从包里拿出一张墙纸，递给张嫂，“贴这个，盖住。”
张嫂接过去，看了一眼墙纸的颜色，又看了看墙面，点了点头。
沈南枝走到门口，往外看了一眼。对面二十米远的地方，白若溪的柜台也在收尾。她的装修风格不一样，粉色的墙面，白色的货柜，灯光是暖黄色的，看着更柔美一些。柜台里已经摆上了一些货，亮闪闪的，远远看过去花花绿绿一片。
白若溪站在柜台后面，正在跟一个店员交代什么。她穿着一件米白色的毛衣，头发散着，侧脸的线条很柔，跟整个柜台的风格很搭。
沈南枝看了一会儿，转身进去了。
开业定在周六。
何婉清选的日子，说周末人多，商场搞活动，能蹭一波客流。她还联系了第一百货的企划部，在商场门口的海报栏里加了一行字——“南枝手作，港城珠宝展参展品牌，新店开业全场九折。”
这行字不大，但位置好，在一楼大门口最显眼的地方。
白若溪的柜台也选了同一天开业。沈南枝是听张嫂说的，张嫂去商场送东西的时候看见白若溪那边也在贴海报，海报上写着“若溪饰品，港城新款，开业全场七折。”
七折。
又是价格战。
沈南枝站在柜台后面，手里拿着一块绒布在擦玻璃展柜，擦得很慢，一下一下的。
何婉清从外面进来，手里拿着一份商场的活动单页，往桌上一拍。
“她疯了。七折，她那点利润全搭进去。”
“她进的货成本低，”沈南枝说，“广州那些工厂货，批发价是咱们的三分之一。打七折她还有得赚。”
何婉清拉开椅子坐下来，把活动单页又看了一遍。
“那咱们呢？跟不跟？”
“不跟。”
“全场不打折？”
“不打。但银花系列也不打折，原价卖。”沈南枝把手里的绒布放下，“九折那个是给老款清库存的，清完就不打了。”
何婉清想了想，点了下头。“行。那咱们比什么？”
沈南枝从柜台下面拿出一摞小卡片，推到何婉清面前。卡片是定做的，硬纸，米白色的底，上面烫金印着一行字——“南枝手作·每一件都是独一无二”。
“以后每卖出一件银花系列，随货附一张卡片，上面有产品的编号和设计日期。我在上面签字。”
何婉清拿起一张卡片，翻来覆去看了看。
“签字？”
“对。我的名字。”
何婉清看着她，嘴角动了一下，不是笑，是那种“你这招有点意思”的表情。
“行。这就不是价格能比的了。”
周六早上，第一百货大楼门口还没开门，已经有人在等了。
沈南枝六点半就到了，何婉清比她更早，已经在柜台里整理样品了。桂姨抱着珠珠跟在后面，珠珠还没睡醒，趴在桂姨肩膀上，嘴里叼着半根油条，油条在嘴边晃来晃去，快掉了又咬一口。
老李最后检查了一遍货架的螺丝，紧了两个松的，拍了拍手上的灰，拎着工具箱走了。
九点整，商场开门。
人流涌进来，比沈南枝预想的多。一楼中庭的位置好，进来的顾客第一眼就能看见“南枝手作”的招牌。白底金字，不花哨，但显眼。展柜里的银花系列在射灯下亮得刺眼，好几个人路过的时候停下来，凑近了看。
“这是银的？手工编的？”一个烫着卷发的女人趴在玻璃上往里看，眼睛离展柜只有一拳的距离。
沈南枝走过去，把展柜打开，拿出那款项链，放在黑色绒布垫上让她看。
content_en:
On the twelfth day of counter decoration, Lao Li installed the last piece of glass.
Shen Nanzhi stood in front of the counter and looked at it for a long time. White walls, dark wooden containers, and warm spotlights shine on the few silver flower samples in the glass display cabinets. The silver-woven petals are dazzling under the light, and the amethyst inlaid in the center of the flower reveals a small piece of purple light, which casts on the velvet underneath, like a small pool of water.
He Wanqing stood next to her, folded her arms and looked at it for a while, then took out a tape measure from her bag and measured the distance between the display cabinet and the door.
"The cashier is placed here," she pointed to the position against the wall. "Customers come in and look at the display cabinets first, and then check out here. The flow of traffic must be smooth, and no people can go back and forth."
Shen Nanzhi nodded and went through the entire layout in his mind. When you enter the door, you face the display cabinet. On the left are earrings and bracelets, on the right are necklaces and brooches, and at the end is the cashier. When customers come in from the door, they will naturally be attracted by the display cabinets, then walk along the shelves, and after looking around, they will arrive at the checkout counter. No detours, no looking back.
Aunt Gui squatted on the ground and wiped the bottom of the shelf very carefully. She even wiped the bottom partition three times. Mrs. Zhang was nailing a hook to the wall. When she hammered it down, the nail became crooked. She pulled it out and nailed it again, leaving a small hole in the wall. He Wanqing frowned but said nothing. She took out a piece of wallpaper from her bag and handed it to Mrs. Zhang, "Paste this and cover it."
Mrs. Zhang took it, looked at the color of the wallpaper, looked at the wall again, and nodded.
Shen Nanzhi walked to the door and took a look outside. Twenty meters away opposite, Bai Ruoxi's counter was also finishing work. Her decoration style is different, with pink walls, white containers, and warm yellow lighting, which makes it look softer. There are already some goods on the counter, which are shiny and colorful from a distance.
Bai Ruoxi was standing behind the counter, explaining something to a clerk. She was wearing an off-white sweater, her hair was loose, and her profile was very soft, which matched the style of the entire counter.
Shen Nanzhi looked at it for a while, then turned and went in.
The opening is scheduled for Saturday.
He Wanqing said that there are many people on weekends, and the shopping mall holds activities, which can attract a wave of customers. She also contacted the planning department of the First Department Store and added a line to the poster board at the entrance of the mall - "Nanzhi Handmade, a brand participating in the Hong Kong Jewelry Exhibition, 10% off for the new store opening."
This line is not big, but it is in a good location, the most conspicuous place at the entrance to the first floor.
Bai Ruoxi's counter also chose the same day to open. Shen Nanzhi heard what Mrs. Zhang said. When Mrs. Zhang went to the mall to deliver things, she saw Bai Ruoxi also putting up a poster. The poster said, "Ruoxi jewelry, new model in Hong Kong City, 30% off for opening."
30% off.
It's a price war again.
Shen Nanzhi stood behind the counter, holding a velvet cloth in his hand and wiping the glass display cabinet, wiping it slowly, one step at a time.
He Wanqing came in from outside, holding a shopping mall activity leaflet in her hand, and slapped it on the table.
"She's crazy. Thirty percent off, and all her profits go into it."
"The cost of the goods she buys is low," Shen Nanzhi said. "The wholesale price of those factory goods in Guangzhou is one-third of ours. She still makes a profit at a 30% discount."
He Wanqing pulled out the chair, sat down, and read the activity sheet again.
"What about us? Are you going to follow?"
"Don't follow."
"No discounts at all?"
"No. But the Silver Flower series will not be discounted. They will be sold at the original price." Shen Nanzhi put down the velvet in his hand. "The 10% discount is for clearing the inventory of old models. Once the clearance is completed, we will not sell it."
He Wanqing thought for a while and nodded. "Okay. Then what should we compete with?"
Shen Nanzhi took out a stack of small cards from under the counter and pushed them in front of He Wanqing. The card is custom-made, made of hard paper, with an off-white background, and a line of words gilded on it - "Handmade by Nanzhi, each piece is unique."
"Every time a piece of the Silver Flower series is sold in the future, a card will be attached with the product, which has the product number and design date. I will sign on it."
He Wanqing picked up a card and looked at it over and over.
"Sign?"
"Yes. My name."
He Wanqing looked at her, and the corners of her mouth moved. It wasn't a smile, but an expression that said, "You're doing something interesting."
"Okay. The price can't be compared."
On Saturday morning, before the door of the First Department Store opened, people were already waiting.
Shen Nanzhi arrived at half past six. He Wanqing was earlier than her and was already sorting samples at the counter. Aunt Gui followed behind with Zhuzhu in her arms. Zhuzhu was still sleeping, lying on Aunt Gui's shoulder with half a fried dough stick in her mouth. The fried dough stick was dangling around her mouth, and she almost dropped it and took another bite.
Lao Li checked the screws on the shelf one last time, tightened the two loose ones, patted the dust on his hands, and left with the tool box.
At nine o'clock sharp, the mall opens.
More people poured in than Shen Nanzhi expected. The location of the atrium on the first floor is good. Customers who come in can see the "Nanzhi Handmade" sign at the first sight. Gold lettering on a white background, not fancy, but eye-catching. The silver flower series in the showcase were so bright under the spotlights that several people stopped and took a closer look when they passed by.
"Is this silver? Hand-knitted?" A woman with curly hair leaned on the glass and looked in, her eyes only a punch away from the display cabinet.
Shen Nanzhi walked over, opened the display cabinet, took out the necklace, and placed it on the black velvet mat for her to see.
